lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, is this the father of Rahul?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I am calling from the police station. Your son has been caught in a rape case with three other boys.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: He is with us. If you want to save his career we can settle it here without FIR. Do not call anyone, otherwise media will come.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Send fifty thousand on this UPI number immediately and I will release him.
